big_case.notes: The petition presented salient questions regarding the scrutiny standard for sex-based correctional policies applied to transgender detainees (Turner v. Safley vs. heightened scrutiny) and cross-sex strip searches, drawing a 23-State amicus brief and a CVSG. However, because United States v. Skrmetti (2025) and West Virginia v. B.P.J. (2026) intervened and the Tenth Circuit had avoided the Turner issue on party-presentation grounds in an interlocutory posture, the case resolved via a routine follow-on GVR without generating new Supreme Court precedent.
